## TemplateEngine.\_processGInvoiceBlocks() method

Parses `<g-invoice>` blocks into Telegram invoice definitions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGInvoiceBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: IInvoiceBlock;
    };
```

An object mapping language keys to their invoice configurations

## Remarks

Each block carries its payment fields as attributes (`title`<!-- -->, `description`<!-- -->, `payload`<!-- -->, `currency`<!-- -->, optional `lang`<!-- -->) with 1 or more self-closing `<g-price label amount/>` line items as children. Raw attribute strings are preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation; `amount` is parsed to a number eagerly (`NaN` when non-numeric — rejected by the validator and at runtime). Structural rules (required attrs, `provider_token` rejection, price count, limits) are enforced by `validateBlockGInvoiceAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const invoices = TemplateEngine._processGInvoiceBlocks(`<g-invoice title="VIP {{days}} hari" description="Akses" payload="{{orderId}}" currency="XTR"><g-price label="VIP" amount="100"/></g-invoice>`);
// Result: { default: { title: 'VIP {{days}} hari', description: 'Akses', payload: '{{orderId}}', currency: 'XTR', prices: [{label: 'VIP', amount: 100}] } }
```
